notes: Seed URL www.votelubbock.org/elections-office/ returns HTTP 403 over http and HTTP 202 with an empty body over https; votelubbock.gov (named in a web search as the county elections site) also returns HTTP 202 with an empty body, including on a refreshed fetch, so the county's results page could not be read. lubbockcounty.gov home page has no election results link. EIDs were not probed by guessing. The Clarity Connect site lubbock-tx.connect.clarityelections.com is robots-disallowed for the fetch module. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin).
